title: A set with vanishing tangential and nonpositive normal distributional derivative is a half-space (Simon 4.3 (8)–(9))
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with |v| = 1, and F₀ ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} Borel. Suppose ∫_{F₀} Dζ(z)(w) dL^{m+1}(z) = 0 for every C¹ compactly supported ζ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ and every w with ⟨w, v⟩ = 0, and ∫_{F₀} Dζ(z)(v) dL^{m+1}(z) ≤ 0 for every such ζ with ζ ≥ 0. Then L^{m+1}(F₀) = 0, or L^{m+1}(ℝ^{m+1} \ F₀) = 0, or there is c ∈ ℝ with L^{m+1}(F₀ Δ {z : ⟨z, v⟩ > c}) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F₀ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (v : Euclid (m + 1)), ‖v‖ = 1 → MeasurableSet F₀ → (∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ w : Euclid (m + 1), inner ℝ w v = 0 → ∫ z in F₀, fderiv ℝ ζ z w = 0) → (∀ ζ : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → ∫ z in F₀, fderiv ℝ ζ z v ≤ 0) → volume F₀ = 0 ∨ volume F₀ᶜ = 0 ∨ ∃ c : ℝ, volume (symmDiff F₀ {z | c < inner ℝ z v}) = 0
